view.title: Insurance claim processor v2 - Component view (intake step function)
view.caption: Opens the Intake step function container from the Container view. Each component runs as a state of the Intake workflow, except where Event routing delivers events directly (edges 29 and 30); edges show the per-batch and per-claim data flow. Edges carry numbers resolved in the edge-detail table.

omitted.label: Intake workflow orchestration
omitted.note: every component below is invoked as a state of the Intake workflow container, except the Event routing entries (edges 29 and 30)

omitted.label: Claim data store
omitted.note: every component reads and writes only its own S3 prefix (single writer per prefix)

omitted.label: Propose Quality Rule Change and Answer Adjuster Question
omitted.note: these run in the Operator CLI container, not in this step function

nodes.label: Admit Intake Batch
detail: S3 conditional-put lock with takeover; registers the partition
intake contract version in the key path `intake/v=1/…`; attachment keys confined to `raw/claims/<claim_id>/` (M3)
lock correctness: holder ARN == `$$.Execution.Id` → self-retry proceeds; `states:DescribeExecution` for takeover; `CreatePartition` `AlreadyExistsException` counts as success (M13)
pins the DQ config per batch; `config_source=fallback` → batch quarantined, fail closed (M17)

nodes.label: Intake Rule Catalog
detail: defines each rule once and renders the DQDL (ADR 0019)
completeness renders as non-empty; header exact-match → `invalid_schema`; report_date ≥ loss_date; exactly one CSV per partition (M3)

nodes.label: Gate Batch Quality
detail: quarantines the whole batch below the score threshold
catalog hash stamped into the Glue ruleset description and compared (M17)

nodes.label: Gate Claim Rows
detail: quarantines blocking rows, flags warnings, splits claims

nodes.label: Canonicalize Values
detail: dates, amounts, policy numbers, VINs under configured formats and date orders
a date with day ≤ 12 valid both ways → blocking `dq_warn:ambiguous_date` unless independently corroborated; date order keyed by source / issuer, not channel (M2)

nodes.label: Assess Narrative Quality
detail: deterministic checks and score

nodes.label: Redact Sensitive Data
detail: typed placeholders before persistence (ADR 0020)
adds `DRIVER_ID`, `PASSPORT_NUMBER` and peer PII types; transcripts and OCR text are redacted, not verified; stdlib scrub of runs of ≥ 4 digits in transcripts (M6)

nodes.label: Extract Language Insights
detail: sentiment is context only, never a decision input

nodes.label: Read Document Text
detail: answers below confidence 80 are never reconciliation sources

nodes.label: Transcribe Call
detail: redacted speaker turns; context, not a reconciliation source

nodes.label: Summarize Loss History
detail: deterministic text and stats; no FM

nodes.label: Reconcile Claim Facts
detail: per-field agreement across sources; uses Canonicalize Values
unverifiable is not clean: blocking `recon_unverifiable:<field>`, `source_disabled:<src>`, `history_failed`, `history_unavailable` (M4)

nodes.label: Format Model Context
detail: tagged, lineage-attributed sections then images (ADR 0021)
claim-derived sections travel in Converse `guardContent`; instructions, schema and policy excerpts as plain `text`; images as plain `image` blocks, not guardrail-checked (H-F14-a)
an image only when OCR confidence is insufficient and no PII was found; OCR insufficient with PII found: blocking `image_withheld:pii`; OCR sufficient: no image, no flag (M6)
escapes `<` and `>` in claimant-derived text inside the context tags (M10)

nodes.label: Assemble Claim Bundle
detail: bundle plus lineage plus quality block; copies images (ADR 0017)
writes the revision-scoped key `bundles/<claim_id>/r<rev>` (M12)

nodes.label: Dispatch Claim Decision
detail: one decision execution per claim revision
resubmitting a decided claim → human review only, unless it is a DQ-owner-tagged proposal re-run (M5)
passes the bundle key plus its S3 VersionId in the v1 input (M12)

nodes.label: Account Batch Outcome
detail: conservation: rows in equals processed plus quarantined plus failed
quarantine records hold no values: row index + rule ids + object version (M9)
second entry: a FAILED / TIMED_OUT / ABORTED intake execution → `batch_failed` summary + `BatchFailed{Status}` metric (M14)

nodes.label: Aggregate Themes
detail: ranked batch phrases and entity types

nodes.label: Measure Extraction Agreement
detail: FM fields versus sources, per field and channel
the measuring prompt hides the intake record; degraded results are excluded (M5)
feedback records hold no values (M9)

edges.detail: Admit Intake Batch hands the admitted, registered batch to Gate Batch Quality.
Intake Rule Catalog renders the DQDL ruleset that Gate Batch Quality submits.
Gate Batch Quality starts and polls the ruleset run on the batch partition.
Gate Batch Quality passes a fit batch to Gate Claim Rows.
Intake Rule Catalog supplies the row checks with their severities to Gate Claim Rows.
Gate Claim Rows canonicalizes raw row values with Canonicalize Values.
Gate Claim Rows sends each claim's narrative to Assess Narrative Quality.
Gate Claim Rows sends each claim's document images to Read Document Text.
Gate Claim Rows sends each claim's call recording to Transcribe Call.
Gate Claim Rows sends each claim's policy number to Summarize Loss History.
Assess Narrative Quality passes the scored narrative to Redact Sensitive Data.
Read Document Text redacts OCR text with Redact Sensitive Data.
Redact Sensitive Data detects PII offsets through Comprehend.
Redact Sensitive Data passes redacted narrative text to Extract Language Insights.
Extract Language Insights detects entities, key phrases and sentiment through Comprehend.
Read Document Text analyzes document images through Textract QUERIES.
Transcribe Call starts and polls a redacted transcription job.
Extract Language Insights hands narrative facts to Reconcile Claim Facts.
Read Document Text hands confidence-gated OCR answers to Reconcile Claim Facts.
Summarize Loss History hands the loss-history summary and frequency flag to Reconcile Claim Facts.
Gate Claim Rows hands canonical intake fields and warning flags to Reconcile Claim Facts.
Reconcile Claim Facts passes reconciled facts and mismatch flags to Format Model Context.
Transcribe Call passes redacted dialog turns to Format Model Context.
Format Model Context passes Converse context blocks to Assemble Claim Bundle.
Assemble Claim Bundle passes the written bundle key to Dispatch Claim Decision.
Dispatch Claim Decision starts one decision execution per claim revision and does not wait.
Assemble Claim Bundle reports each claim's fate to Account Batch Outcome.
Extract Language Insights feeds key phrases and entity types to Aggregate Themes.
Event routing routes failed intake executions (FAILED, TIMED_OUT, ABORTED) to Account Batch Outcome for batch-failure accounting (M14).
Event routing delivers decision-record events to Measure Extraction Agreement.
